# Junyuan Secondary School

> > Official website for Junyuan Secondary School, a Singapore MOE secondary school providing academic programs, CCAs, student support services, and character development.

Junyuan Secondary School operates under Singapore's Ministry of Education (MOE), offering comprehensive secondary education with Mother Tongue Languages, ICT integration, and the CHAMPs framework. The school uses MOE platforms including Student iCON, Student Learning Space (SLS), and Parents Gateway for digital learning and parent communication.

## Key Topics

- Junyuan Secondary School
- Ministry of Education (MOE)
- Student iCON

## Student Services & Support

- [Contact Us](https://junyuansec.moe.edu.sg/student-information/sec-1-students/contact-us): Contact information for Sec 1 students and school administrative services
- [Parents Gateway](https://junyuansec.moe.edu.sg/other-information/parents-gateway): MOE-GovTech Parents Gateway mobile app for school communication and admin
- [Student iCON Accounts](https://junyuansec.moe.edu.sg/student-information/student-ict-matters/student-icon-accounts): Student iCON, MIMS, SSOE, and SLS account management and password reset
- [Financial Assistance Scheme](https://junyuansec.moe.edu.sg/other-information/financial-assistance-scheme): MOE Financial Assistance Scheme application and student aid information
- [Internal Examination Matters](https://junyuansec.moe.edu.sg/student-information/internal-examination-matters): Internal examination rules, timetables, and student exam information
- [Emergency Evacuation Procedures](https://junyuansec.moe.edu.sg/other-information/school-safety-information/emergency-evacuation-procedures): Emergency evacuation procedures and safety protocols for school drills

## Academic Programmes & Curriculum

- [N Level Results Release 2025](https://junyuansec.moe.edu.sg/n-level-results-release-2025): N-Level 2025 results release info with ITE, DPP, and PFP pathways
- [Mother Tongue Languages](https://junyuansec.moe.edu.sg/academic-programmes/mother-tongue-languages): MTL curriculum, cultural education, CPEF, and heritage appreciation programs
- [Sexuality Education Programme](https://junyuansec.moe.edu.sg/school-programmes/character-n-citizenship/sexuality-education-programme): MOE Sexuality Education curriculum for character, citizenship, and values

## Co-Curricular Activities (CCA)

- [Infocomm Technology (Media Production)](https://junyuansec.moe.edu.sg/cca/clubs-and-society/infocommm-technology-media-production): Media production CCA covering photography and videography with student leaders
- [Girls' Brigade](https://junyuansec.moe.edu.sg/cca/uniformed-groups/girls-brigade): Girls' Brigade 56th Coy uniformed group CCA for servant leadership

## School Organisation & Staff

- [Allied Educators](https://junyuansec.moe.edu.sg/our-identity/school-organisation/allied-educators): Allied educators staff for counselling, student welfare, and special needs
- [Science Department](https://junyuansec.moe.edu.sg/our-identity/school-organisation/teaching-staff/science): Science department teaching staff directory and contact information
- [ICT Department](https://junyuansec.moe.edu.sg/our-identity/school-organisation/teaching-staff/ict): ICT department teaching staff directory including Mrs Kho and team

## News & Student Recognition
